correctness.rationale: The centered path vector has all nonmiddle increments 1 and middle increment 2r. A universal Rayleigh bound holds for all admissible edge assignments. Exact prefix-flux telescoping uniquely constructs positive saturating weights, and the Sturm oscillation theorem identifies the constructed eigenvalue as the first positive Laplacian eigenvalue for all m≥2. Monotone one-variable budget equation has one r>1/2 for every 0<u<u0. Equality conditions force the same vector and every edge conductance, establishing global uniqueness without symmetry. Small-cap expansion, threshold continuity and the rational six-vertex example were recomputed; the standalone exact-rational verifier prints VERIFY_OK 9911 and independently checks hundreds of rational family parameters. Numerical checks are not substituted for the universal analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The 1990/2008 unconstrained total-budget path allocation is explicitly prior art, so newness is confined to the capped-central-edge constrained regime, its sharp active-set transition and globally unique exact optimizer against all asymmetric edge assignments. The 2015 interlayer-link threshold, generic Laplacian semidefinite optimization, and 2004 fixed-neighbor edge sensitivity are not stronger statements on this precise simultaneous capacity-and-budget family. The 2004 paper was abstract-only, posing a stated residual priority risk. Semantic database search returned only non-implicative nearest analogues, not a direct theorem; absence in search is not a novelty proof.
residual_risks: Kirkland and Neumann (2004) primary full text could not be read, so its appendices or unstated implications remain unchecked.
Other unindexed literature or unpublished equivalent constrained path formulas may exist; semantic search does not prove absolute novelty.
The unconstrained u≥u0 branch is prior coverage and is included for a complete phase classification, not claimed as a distinct discovery.

value.rationale: A total-resource network with one bottleneck edge capacity is a natural fastest-consensus and heat-diffusion design model. The theorem gives a sharp all-order physical cap threshold u0, a global closed scalar equation for the binding weights, strict positivity and asymmetry-resistant uniqueness, and the sharp collapse law λ2~2u/m. These substantive features are not automatic from a general SDP or the already-known uncapped tree optimum.
